messages:
Sophie (Product): quick heads-up 1: we need to finalize the observability mini-MVP scope today. customers are asking for fast wins: per-route cost visibility, basic tracing hooks, and an errors rollup view. whos got objections to a small, ship-fast slice?
Tom (Eng): no objections but a hard constraint: full-span tracing + detailed token metadata is a blocker for latency and storage. suggest we do sampled spans + carry forward route/service tags only.
Nina (SRE): agree. propose default sample_rate=0.10 with easy per-account override. also insist on agent-side PII scrubbing and a graceful fallback when collector is down.
Carlos (Data): for per-route cost we can attribute tokens to routes if the app sends model_id + input/output token_counts. aggregated buckets (daily) for 90 days keeps storage low. I can prototype SQL for rollups.
Mei (CS): customers care about actionable alerts: notify on sudden cost spikes (>25% week-over-week) and top-10 costy routes. CSV export is a must for finance teams.
Yara (Design): plan a single compact card: left column top routes by spend, middle column cost trend sparkline, right column top error groups. mobile-first and ARIA colors. figma: https://figma.com/s/obs-mini-tile-v2
deploy-bot: staging deploy passed (artifact 50612): https://ci.internal/build/50612 :white_check_mark:
Sophie (Product): consensus forming. MVP scope = 1) per-route cost card + CSV export, 2) sampled tracing hooks with tag carryover, 3) errors rollup with grouping & basic stack snippet. open: sampling default, retention, and acceptance tests.
Tom (Eng): tech acceptance criteria: tracing hook must not increase request p50 by >3ms; sampling config exposed via API + console; collector failures must not block requests.
Nina (SRE): ops acceptance: expected storage delta <10% on default sampling; add alerts for span parsing errors and PII hits; retention policy: aggregated metrics 90 days, raw sampled spans 14 days.
Carlos (Data): data acceptance: route-level cost should be within 2% of invoiced usage on audit customers; CSV for 30 days <20s generation for <100k routes.
Mei (CS): customer acceptance: Pilot signoff from ParcelCo, MediSys, FinLedger required for GA. If any decline on CSV/alerts, push GA.
Yara (Design): UX acceptance: card fits 320px width, accessible contrast, export button visible and labeled "Export spend CSV". legal approved redaction copy.
Tom (Eng): example agent config we'll expose: ```yaml
observability:
  tracing_enabled: true
  sample_rate: 0.10  # float 0..1
  pii_scrub: true
  fallback_mode: local_aggregate
```
Nina (SRE): add note: safe-mode if collector unreachable -> aggregate counts locally, drop verbose payloads after 30s buffer.
Sophie (Product): timeline proposal: sprint A (1 week) behind feature flag alpha; sprint B (2 wks) pilot with three customers; GA earliest after 2-week pilot and signoffs.
Mei (CS): I'll schedule Pilot kickoff with ParcelCo + MediSys + FinLedger this week.
Carlos (Data): I'll mock ETL and run reconciliation on two internal tenants, ETA 48 hours.
Tom (Eng): I'll run perf harness and storage model and post numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Nina (SRE): I'll author playbook for alert responses and PII incident flow.
Sophie (Product): action items recap: @Tom perf + storage, @Carlos ETL + reconciliation, @Mei customer coordination, @Yara ship tile mocks. reconvene Fri 9:30am PT. :rocket:
